description: Hot and Sour Soup is a classic Chinese comfort food, renowned for its tantalizing balance of tangy vinegar and fiery white pepper. This hearty soup is packed with tender pork, silky tofu, and various mushrooms, offering a delightful interplay of textures and flavors. It is a perfect appetizer or a light meal, warming you from the inside out with every savory spoonful.

instructions.title: Prepare Ingredients
instructions.text: Julienne the pork loin, firm tofu, rehydrated shiitake mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms, and bamboo shoots. Ensure all ingredients are uniformly cut for even cooking and texture. Prepare the cornstarch slurry by mixing cornstarch with water.

instructions.title: Simmer Broth and Main Ingredients
instructions.text: In a large pot, bring chicken broth to a boil. Add the julienned pork and simmer for 2-3 minutes until cooked through. Then add the sliced shiitake mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms, and bamboo shoots. Reduce heat and let it simmer for 5 minutes.

instructions.title: Add Seasonings and Tofu
instructions.text: Stir in the rice vinegar, soy sauce, and white pepper. Taste and adjust seasonings as needed, adding more vinegar or pepper for your preferred level of hot and sour. Gently add the julienned tofu to the simmering soup.

instructions.title: Thicken the Soup
instructions.text: Slowly pour the cornstarch slurry into the soup while stirring continuously to prevent lumps. Continue to stir until the soup thickens to your desired consistency. If it becomes too thick, add a little more broth.

instructions.title: Incorporate Egg Ribbons
instructions.text: Once the soup is thickened, slowly drizzle the beaten egg into the hot soup in a thin stream while stirring gently in a circular motion. This will create beautiful egg ribbons throughout the soup.

instructions.title: Finish and Serve
instructions.text: Remove the soup from heat. Stir in the sesame oil for an aromatic finish. Ladle the Hot and Sour Soup into individual bowls. Garnish generously with chopped scallions before serving immediately. Enjoy this comforting and flavorful classic.

tips: For authentic flavor, do not skimp on the white pepper. Its unique pungent heat is crucial to the 'hot' aspect of the soup.
Adjust the amount of vinegar and white pepper to your personal preference. Add them gradually and taste as you go.
Serve immediately after preparation to enjoy the soup at its best consistency and temperature. Garnish with fresh cilantro for an extra layer of aroma.
